findings.summary: DECLARATION_PATTERN incorrectly matches control flow keywords (like `if`, `for`, `while`, `catch`, `return`, `switch`) followed by an open parenthesis, causing findRelatedTests to broadly include irrelevant test files.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude keywords using a negative lookahead, e.g., changing `(\w+)` to `(?!(?:if|for|while|catch|switch|return)\b)([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)` in the parenthesis matching group.

findings.summary: parseUnifiedDiff uses `[...existing, newHunk]` to append to the hunks array, causing O(N^2) array copying overhead per file instead of an O(1) push.
findings.suggested_fix: Since `existing` is a mutable array internal to parseUnifiedDiff, use `existing.push(newHunk)` rather than replacing the array with a spread copy.
